title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1966-05-19
lineage: MR > DAT > FM Broadcast > CDR > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1966 set, highlighted by blazing Rider, Mindbender and the rare Cream Puff War.
ai_review.review: The recording—taken from a vintage soundboard—offers surprisingly clear, listenable audio for a show over three decades old, with only minor quirks noted by a few reviewers. Musically the concert is a fire‑cracker of early Dead blues, featuring standout performances of Rider, Mindbender, Cream Puff War, Minglewood Blues and Pigpen’s organ‑driven Good Lovin’. Overall the band sounds loose yet ecstatic, delivering a dance‑ready set that many fans deem essential.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews (5‑star and 4‑star) praise both the show’s energy and the surprisingly good soundboard quality; only a handful of lower or mixed scores exist, leading to a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp for its era; some listeners note slight pitch/slowness and occasional quirks in the mix, but overall clarity and balance are praised.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑1966 set that swings from raw blues to upbeat dance numbers, maintaining a tight yet loose feel with memorable transitions and rare tracks.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s scorching blues licks and guitar work are repeatedly praised as a highlight of the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is described as “fire” and “sweet blues bass,” with Phil keeping the groove strong despite occasional muddiness in the mix.
band_member_comments.Drums: Billy’s drumming on Viola Lee Blues is called fantastic; overall drum work noted as energetic and raw.
